tests.name: H2O-T-B3LYP
tests.description: Water, triplet UKS B3LYP / cc-pVTZ — TFVC populations, local spin, ENPART (DFT), fragments O and H2, VERBOSE 1 (intermediate matrices, also before the zero-error correction). THREBOD 2000 skips the H–H pair (bond order 0.16): unrestricted multipolar paths, DFT part and HF-type exchange part.

checks.label: 1 pair below THREBOD takes the multipolar estimate
Pure KS-DFT XC energy, one-center exact (au)
Electron-electron energy before the zero-error correction (au)
H-H DFT part, skipped pair: 0.8 x multipolar (au)
H-H HF-type exchange, skipped pair: multipolar (au)
H-H complete xc, skipped pair: multipolar (au)
Fragment H2 IQA self-energy, includes the skipped H-H pair (au)

tests.name: C2H6-B3LYP
tests.description: Ethane, RKS B3LYP — TFVC populations, full ENPART (DFT) with THREBOD 5 and a 40 × 146 two-electron grid; the largest ENPART case (8 atoms, 160 basis functions).

tests.name: CH3F
tests.description: Fluoromethane, RKS DFT — TFVC populations, fragment OSLO.

tests.name: CH3F-pySCF
tests.description: Fluoromethane, RKS B3LYP from pySCF (utils/apost3d.py .fchk, no "Orthonormal basis" block) — TFVC, fragment OSLO and its .fchk export.

tests.name: H2-T-OSLO
tests.description: H2 triplet, UKS B3LYP from pySCF — TFVC, fragment OSLO with no beta electrons (empty beta channel) and a linear-dependency check with more candidates than electrons.

checks.label: Empty beta channel skipped
checks.pattern: No electrons in this channel: nothing to localize

tests.name: C2H6-OSLO-2CH3
tests.description: Ethane, RKS B3LYP, two CH3 fragments: OSLO selects the C-C bond from both fragments in the last iteration (the same orbital), which is shared half and half, so both fragments get oxidation state 0.

checks.label: Last selection spans one orbital
checks.pattern: Shared orbital: the 2 selected OSLOs span 1 orbital

tests.name: H2-S-OSLO
tests.description: H2 singlet, UKS B3LYP from pySCF, one fragment per atom: in each spin channel the only orbital is found from both fragments and shared half and half (oxidation states 0); BRANCH_ALPHA at an iteration with no other candidate and BRANCH_BETA at one never reached are reported, not applied.

checks.label: Selection spans one orbital (alpha)
checks.pattern: Shared orbital: the 2 selected OSLOs span 1 orbital

checks.label: BRANCH_ALPHA 1 with no other candidate
checks.pattern: Branching asked at this iteration, but there is no other candidate: not applied

checks.label: BRANCH_BETA 2 never reached
checks.pattern: Branching at iteration 2: not reached, not applied

tests.name: H2-T-OSLO-CLOSE
tests.description: H2 triplet at 0.60 Å, UKS B3LYP from pySCF, one fragment per atom: in the alpha channel the first selection takes both orbitals (delta-FOLI 0.29926), so the close-alternative check is skipped: every next OSLO lies in the selected space. The genuine warning is tested by C3H7F-OSLO-CLOSE.

checks.label: Close-alternative check skipped (no orbital left)
checks.pattern: Close alternatives: not checked, no orbital left after this selection

tests.name: CH3F-OSLO-BRANCH
tests.description: Fluoromethane, RKS DFT, fragment OSLO with BRANCH_ITERATION 6: the last iteration selects the next FOLI value, so the C-F bond goes to CH3 (F +1, CH3 -1) and the sum of FOLI values rises from 9.60435 to 10.96340.
